probe.name: V3_dense_rank_max_asc
probe.sql:
SELECT timestamp,
       sum(tract_count) AS metadata_rows_count,
       max(rk_asc) AS model_count,
       sum(bldg_weight) AS units_count,
       sum(bs_elec * bldg_weight) AS elec_baseline,
       sum(up_elec * bldg_weight) AS elec_upgrade,
       sum((coalesce(bs_elec, 0) - coalesce(up_elec, 0)) * bldg_weight) AS elec_savings
FROM (
  SELECT ts_aggr.timestamp, ts_aggr.bs_elec, ts_aggr.up_elec,
         bs_per_bldg.bldg_id, bs_per_bldg.tract_count, bs_per_bldg.bldg_weight,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts_aggr.timestamp ORDER BY bs_per_bldg.bldg_id ASC) AS rk_asc
  FROM (
  SELECT ts_flat.state AS state, ts_flat.timestamp AS timestamp, ts_flat.bldg_id AS bldg_id,
         sum(ts_flat.elec) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=0) AS bs_elec,
         sum(ts_flat.elec) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=1) AS up_elec,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE ts_flat.upgrade=0) AS _inner_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT ts.state AS state, ts.bldg_id AS bldg_id,
           date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, ts.timestamp)) AS timestamp,
           ts.upgrade AS upgrade,
           ts."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption" AS elec
    FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state AS ts
    WHERE ts.upgrade IN (0, 1) AND ts.state IN ('CO', 'NM')
  ) AS ts_flat
  GROUP BY ts_flat.state, ts_flat.timestamp, ts_flat.bldg_id
) AS ts_aggr
  JOIN (
  SELECT bs.bldg_id AS bldg_id, bs.state AS state,
         sum(bs.weight) AS bldg_weight,
         count(*) AS tract_count
  FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs
  WHERE bs.upgrade = 0 AND bs.state IN ('CO', 'NM')
  GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs.state
) AS bs_per_bldg ON bs_per_bldg.bldg_id = ts_aggr.bldg_id AND bs_per_bldg.state = ts_aggr.state
) sub
GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY 1
